title: potentilla palustris subf. subglabra
intro: Potentilla palustris subf. subglabra, commonly known as Marsh Cinquefoil, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, offering potential health benefits in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Cinquefoil are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the health benefits and therapeutic potential of Potentilla palustris subf. subglabra, but its bioactive constituents suggest its promise in traditional medicine.
